message.content:
**神舟八号（Shenzhou 8）** 是中国空间站计划中的一次“无人试验飞行”。它于 **2008 年 9 月 25 日** 发射，主要目的是验证与空间站对接系统以及舱外操作（如机械臂）的功能。由于是一次“无人”试验，**没有宇航员乘坐**。

> **关键点**  
> - **发射日期**：2008‑09‑25  
> - **任务类型**：无人试验飞行  
> - **主要目标**：验证对接技术、舱外操作（机械臂）等  
> - **乘员**：无

如果你想了解后续有人类乘员的神舟系列任务（如神舟九号、十号等），可以告诉我，我会为你提供相关信息。
message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "神舟八号的宇航员是谁" meaning "Who were the astronauts on Shenzhou 8?" They want the names of the crew of Shenzhou 8. Shenzhou 8 was a Chinese spaceflight mission in 2008. It was an unmanned test flight? Actually Shenzhou 8 was the first test flight of the Shenzhou spacecraft with a robotic arm, but it was unmanned. Wait: Shenzhou 8 was an unmanned test flight of the Shenzhou spacecraft, launched on 25 September 2008. It was the first test of the docking system. It had no crew. So answer: It was unmanned, no astronauts. Provide explanation. Also mention that Shenzhou 8 was a test flight, no crew. Provide details.
